Text Message (SMS) Consent

Effective date: October 26, 2026 · Last updated October 26, 2026

This page shows how people opt in to the FlowOps texts program, operated by FlowOps Inc. (flowopsagent.ai) from our FlowOps phone number +1 (833) 589-8939. FlowOps is a scheduling platform for small service businesses. We send appointment confirmations, reschedules and cancellations when a booking is saved. We do not send marketing or promotional text messages.

Messages we send

  • Confirmations
  • Reschedules
  • Cancellations

Each text goes out when that booking is saved, rescheduled, or cancelled. Nothing is scheduled for a time before the appointment.

The booking-form checkbox is the only way to opt in

When a customer books on a FlowOps booking page (for example https://flowopsagent.ai/book/flowops-demo), the “Your details” step asks for name, email and an optional phone number, followed by the checkbox below. The checkbox is unchecked by default and is optional: it is not required to book, and consent is not a condition of purchase. Appointment texts are sent only if the customer enters a mobile number and ticks the box.

We record the opt-in choice and the time it was made with the booking. A confirmation text looks like this:

FlowOps: Your appointment with {Business} is confirmed for Tue Oct 27 at 10:00 AM. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.

Program terms

  • Message frequency varies depending on your bookings.
  • Msg & data rates may apply.
  • STOP: reply STOP to any message to opt out. You will get one confirmation and no further messages. Reply START to resubscribe.
  • HELP: reply HELP for help, or email support@flowopsagent.ai.
  • Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
  • Mobile numbers and text-messaging opt-in data are never sold or shared with third parties for their marketing purposes.

Full details: Terms of Service (section 7, SMS / Text Messaging Terms) at https://flowopsagent.ai/terms and Privacy Policy at https://flowopsagent.ai/privacy.
